newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sodak Gaming up to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sodak Gaming up to buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers Inc analyst Scott Renner said he upgraded his rating on Sodak Gaming Inc to a buy from a hold, and also raised his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $2.00 a share from $1.70.
-- The fiscal 1998 estimate was raised to $3.00 a share from $1.90. Fiscal 1996 remains $1.50 a share.
-- In a report, Renner cited the company's agreement to operate video gaming machines in Brazil and the potential for incremental busienss opportunities in South Africa, Mexico and Latin America.
-- Salomon set a 24-month price target of $75 a share.

-- "Given our conservative assumptions with respect to Brazil and the opportunity set presently facing Sodak, we believe that additional EPS (earnings per share) visibility may materialize over the next 12 months," Renner said. "We believe the stock to move higher as this visibility crystallizes."
